not_votes: comments.mod (the last column of the comments rows: 1 accepted, 0 unmoderated, -1 moderated out) is a moderation status, not a vote.
basis: Generated fixture conversations. generate.py has always written each vote row's draw verbatim as a stored value at agree = -1, and the 272 Delphi route recordings were made from that database. This companion declares that sign; generate.py names each draw by meaning and takes the stored number from delphi/tests/vote_fixtures.py at this declared convention, and generate.py --check refuses a fixture changed after its sign was declared. It sits outside fixtures/ so the recordings' fixture digest is unchanged; no fixture byte is rewritten (P-078 1d).
